info.title: SaveSpace API
info.description: Design doc §11. Paths are relative to /v1.

get.summary: Lists accounts with their latest balances.

post.summary: Finishes passkey sign-in. Sets the session cookie.
Signs out. Works without a valid session, so a stale cookie is removed.

Signs in with a recovery code. The code works once. The new session can
add a passkey right away.

get.summary: Reports whether owner setup can start.

post.summary: Finishes owner setup. Signs the owner in and returns recovery codes.
Starts owner setup. Checks the setup code and returns passkey options.
Starts a passkey check for step-up actions.

get.summary: Lists bank connections and their health.

post.summary: Connects accounts: exchanges the public token and starts the first sync.

delete.summary:
Removes a connection at the bank and deletes its accounts and
transactions. Needs step-up.

post.summary: Creates a Plaid Link token. Needs step-up (§12.1: a new connection).
Finishes adding a passkey. Needs step-up.
Starts adding a passkey. Needs step-up.

delete.summary: Deletes a passkey. The last passkey cannot be deleted. Needs step-up.

post.summary: Replaces the recovery codes with a new set. Needs step-up.

Creates a rule. It applies to past and future transactions, and replaces
a rule with the same match. The person's own edits still win.

delete.summary:
Deletes a rule. Its transactions get the next matching rule or the
automatic category.

get.summary: Lists transactions, newest first, with filters and search.

parameters.name: starting_after
parameters.description: The last transaction ID (`txn_…`) of the previous page.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category (`cat_…`), or `none` for transactions without a category.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in the description, merchant, or note.

parameters.name: include_hidden
parameters.description: Also list hidden transactions. The default is false.

patch.summary: Edits the category, merchant name, note, or hidden state.

put.summary: Replaces the split of a posted transaction.

post.summary:
Receives a Plaid webhook. Plaid signs it with the `Plaid-Verification`
header (ES256 JWT).

available_minor.description: The available balance in minor units.

current_minor.description: The current balance in minor units.

limit_minor.description: The credit limit in minor units.

mask.description: The last digits of the account number.

challenge_id.description: The ID from the start response.

credential.description: The result of `navigator.credentials.create()`, in JSON form.

name.description: A name for this passkey. 1 to 100 characters.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable code, for example `step_up_required`.

message.description: A sentence for a developer. The web app shows its own text.

param.description: The request field that caused the error, if any.

request_id.description: The request ID, the same as the `Request-Id` header.

challenge_id.description: The ID from the start response.

credential.description: The result of `navigator.credentials.get()`, in JSON form.

sensitive.description: Health, giving, and similar. SaveSpace is more careful with these.

challenge_id.description: Send this ID back with the authenticator response. Valid for 5 minutes.

options.description:
Options for `navigator.credentials.create()` or `.get()`, in the
WebAuthn JSON form (binary fields are base64url).

error_code.description: The provider error code of the last failure.

CreateConnectionRequest.description: Connect accounts with the result of Plaid Link.

oneOf.description: The institution from the Link metadata, for display.

ErrorBody.description: The JSON body of every error response.

LinkToken.description: A link token for Plaid Link.

connection_id.description: Set to repair an existing connection (update mode).

calm_mode.description: Calm mode: hide exact balances until the person taps.

step_up_until.description:
Step-up actions are allowed until this time (RFC 3339). A time in the
past means the person must confirm with a passkey first.

time_zone.description: The IANA time zone, for example `America/New_York`.

name.description: The name the person gave it.

RecoverRequest.description: Sign in with a recovery code.

code.description: A recovery code. Case, spaces, and dashes do not matter.

RecoveryCodes.description: Recovery codes. Shown once. Each code works one time.

merchant_name.description: The merchant name, for a merchant rule.

transactions.description:
How many transactions it categorizes now, without those where the
person set the category.

RuleMatchBody.description:
What a rule matches. Set exactly one of `merchant_id` and
`name_contains`.

direction.description: `in` (money in) or `out` (money out). Absent means both.

name_contains.description: Text in the description or merchant name, 2 to 100 characters.

challenge_id.description: The ID from the start response.

credential.description: The result of `navigator.credentials.create()`, in JSON form.

passkey_name.description: A name for this passkey, for example "Laptop". 1 to 100 characters.

display_name.description: The name to show in the app. 1 to 100 characters.

setup_code.description: The one-time setup code from Secret Manager (`owner-setup-code`).

setup_open.description: True if the server has a setup code and no owner exists yet.

amount_minor.description: Same sign as the transaction, not zero.

SplitsRequest.description: The split parts. They must add up to the transaction amount.

splits.description: 2 to 10 parts, or none to remove the split.

StepUp.description: The result of a step-up check.

step_up_until.description: Step-up actions are allowed until this time (RFC 3339).

Transaction.description: A transaction with its category and the person's edits.

amount_minor.description: The amount in minor units. Negative is money out.

category_source.description: Where the category came from: `person`, `rule`, or `provider`.

hidden.description: Hidden from lists, budgets, and insights.

merchant_id.description: The merchant ID (`mer_…`), if SaveSpace found one.

splits.description: The parts, if split. Empty if not.

has_more.description: True if more transactions follow. Pass the last ID as `starting_after`.

UpdateTransactionRequest.description:
The person's edits. A field that is not in the body does not change.
`null` clears it.

category_id.description: The category ID (`cat_…`). `null` gives the automatic category back.

hidden.description: Hide from lists, budgets, and insights.

merchant_name.description: The merchant name to show, up to 100 characters.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Owner setup, passkey sign-in, and step-up checks.
